Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Shared CHUH classroom workspace metadata tracking the active class period, settings, bell schedules, and timer sequences.

activeSectionId.description: Currently selected class period section ID.

settings.description: Shared classroom theme, pass thresholds, dead zone rules, bell schedules, and timer sequence defaults.

createdBy.description: Verified teacher email who initialized the workspace.

updatedBy.description: Verified teacher email who last updated the workspace.

ClassSection.title: ClassSection
ClassSection.description: A class period containing group rules, station assignments, pairing rules, floor plan coordinates, spotlight deck state, and a student subcollection.

name.description: Display name of the class period.

order.description: Sort order index of the class period.

quickSize.description: Target student count per group (0 or 2-6).

forceExactCount.description: Whether to strictly cap station tables to quickCount.

groups.description: Bounded list of up to 8 color table station assignments including optional locks, roles, and points.

passQueue.description: Ordered list of student IDs waiting in line for the restroom pass.

floorPlan.description: 2D spatial classroom floor plan coordinates for tables, teacher desk, and whiteboard edge.

keepApartPairs.description: Bounded list of student pair keys that should not be placed together.

pairTogetherPairs.description: Bounded list of student pair keys that should be grouped together.

recentPairKeys.description: Bounded pairing memory of recent student pairs to avoid back-to-back repeats.

spotlightCalledIds.description: Bounded list of student IDs already drawn in non-repeating Spotlight Deck mode.

spotlightDeckMode.description: Whether Spotlight defaults to non-repeating Deck of Cards mode for this section.

createdBy.description: Verified teacher email who created this section.

updatedBy.description: Verified teacher email who last updated this section.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: A student in a class period with attendance state (present/absent/tardy), optional badge ID, and quarter hall pass tracking.

present.description: Whether the student is in class (present or tardy) for grouping.

badgeCode.description: Optional student ID badge code for kiosk scan check-in/out.

passesUsed.description: Number of quarter bathroom passes used (0-10).

outTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when student left room, or 0 when in class.

activeDestination.description: Destination tag while student is currently out of the room.

createdBy.description: Verified teacher email who added the student.

updatedBy.description: Verified teacher email who last updated the student.

PassLog.title: PassLog
PassLog.description: Editable hall pass audit event when a hall pass is issued, returned, adjusted, or reset.

sectionName.description: Section display name at time of event.

studentName.description: Student display name at time of event.

destination.description: Destination tag for the pass trip.

quotaExempt.description: Whether this pass was exempt from deducting a quarter pass ticket.

passesUsedAfter.description: Student's pass count after this action (0-10).

durationMinutes.description: Elapsed minutes out when returned (0 otherwise).

durationSeconds.description: Exact elapsed seconds out when returned (0 otherwise).

takenAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the pass was taken (0 if not applicable).

returnedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the student returned (0 if not applicable).

actorEmail.description: Verified teacher email who performed the action.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Shared classroom workspace document for authorized CHUH teachers.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/sections/{sect.description: Class period sections belonging to the shared CHUH workspace.
Individual student records with attendance and hall pass counters.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/passLogs/{logI.description: Editable hall pass activity log for live classroom accountability.
